gates.title: Current production cinematic and real creation
gates.scope: Actual production opening, scoped work, candidate output and captured camera continuation only. It does not substitute for seven-project, lifecycle, negative-case or artistic acceptance.

gates.title: Current frozen-candidate full regression
gates.scope: Counts are parsed from the completed current log. Missing logs, incomplete summaries, failures, skips and changed source cannot pass.

gates.title: Current seven-project native views and isolation
gates.scope: Older seven-project/top-side/overview-split observations are historical after UI changes. No inferred carry-forward from a new one-project movie.

gates.title: Current early/mid/late handoff and native negative cases
gates.scope: The current film covers only its recorded timing. Earlier commit timing, history, failure, unknown and cancellation cases require current acceptance.

gates.title: Current native visibility, context and disposal lifecycle
gates.scope: Clean capture shutdown is not the full hidden-view/context-loss/reduced-motion/disposal audit. Older lifecycle checks remain historical after visual/UI changes.

gates.title: Current production live Codex narrow assignment
gates.scope: Only the recorded explicit narrow edit/check/preview in this production candidate; no sustained quota or general provider capability claim.

gates.title: Historical Claude backend component evidence
gates.scope: Historical live provider evidence is applicable only to the listed unchanged backend hashes. It is not a requalification of the current complete UI, native handoff, authentication lifetime or quota.

gates.title: Current GPU bundle reproducibility
gates.scope: Requires the recorded rebuild to equal the current bundle bytes; old bundle evidence does not qualify new visual code.
